audience: fitness studios and clubs that run classes and memberships in PerfectGym

useCases.title: See the class schedule and bookings of a club
useCases.text: List the clubs, then the classes of one club for a date range. Open a class for its attendee count, and list its bookings, including standby and canceled ones.

useCases.title: Find a member and review the contracts
useCases.text: Search members by name or home club. Read one member's record, then list the contracts of that member.

useCases.title: Check contract payments and the upcoming schedule
useCases.text: List the payments made against a contract. Read the upcoming payment schedule of the same contract.

useCases.title: Book a class for a member
useCases.text: Book one class for one member, then check the attendee count. This changes the studio's bookings and may charge the member.

useCases.title: Cancel one class booking
useCases.text: Cancel one class booking by its booking id. The member may lose the class and may be charged a late-cancellation fee.

useCases.title: Add a member note or a sales lead
useCases.text: Add a note to a member's record, which staff can see. Or create a sales lead in a club's CRM.
